system.description: Knives are ubiquitous across the frontier, constructed from industrial diamond laminate layered over a metal or plastic blank. The diamond layering produces a durable, fine-edged blade that almost never needs sharpening. Most integrate a double-edge blade with a flat chisel tip and enlarged pommel.
system.availableFeatures: close combat

system.description: Large, general-purpose blades used for clearing vegetation and self-defense. Single edged, approximately 50cm long, with short serrated saw sections near the grip.
system.availableFeatures: close combat

system.description: Contact weapons that deliver an incapacitating electrical shock. Targets must make a Physique test or be incapacitated.
system.availableFeatures: close combat, warm, rechargeable

system.description: Designed to evade detection — compact, light, and free of metallic parts. Limited ammo capacity and stopping power. Any attempt to hide or conceal gains +2 bonus.

system.description: Favored by law enforcement and criminals alike. Large caliber with considerable stopping power. Common military sidearm. Many colonists carry them for defense against Poseidon wildlife.

system.description: Fires a highly collimated burst of ultrasound. Non-lethal. Useless in low-pressure or vacuum environments. Weapon of choice for orbital security forces. Can shatter glass and crack fragile objects.
system.availableFeatures: warm, smart, rechargeable, low capacity, single

system.description: A painfully irritating chemical agent in a spray canister with pistol grip. Non-lethal self-defense weapon, widely distributed throughout Earth and the colonies.

system.description: Preferred by law enforcement aboard orbital stations and pressurized habitats where damage to pressure-bearing bulkheads could be catastrophic. Military grade models are automatic and typically fire antipersonnel rounds.

system.description: Intended for military and security forces. Reliable, lightweight, capable of fully automatic fire. Can be loaded with a range of ammunition types.

system.description: Popular with Incorporate security, military special ops, criminals, and gangsters. Burst and full-auto capable with handgun-equivalent ammunition.

system.description: Military grade weapon designed to kill at distance from concealment. Used in GEO Armed Forces, Incorporate security, and law enforcement special ops.
